In this video, I started off on a server called the Kings & Queens SMP, where it's everyone's goal to obtain a rare mythic item. Thank you for watching!

Shout out AmyMialee, the developer of Kings & Queen's Mod (It is private, please do not ask for it) 
-https://www.amymialee.dev/ 

『Extras』
» Lunar Cosmetics https://store.lunarclient.com/category/minutetech
» Twitter https://twitter.com/MinuteTech_
» Twitch https://www.twitch.tv/minute
» Instagram https://www.instagram.com/minutetechyt/
» NameMC https://namemc.com/profile/MinuteTech.1

The events in this video are unscripted, and the server is heavily customized with a mix of public data-packs and mods, however the mod that adds all of the mythics, custom items, and rituals is private.
